gavelkind.definition:
n. A tenure by which land descended from the father to all
   his sons in equal portions, and the land of a brother, dying without
   issue, descended equally to his brothers. It still prevails in the
   county of Kent.
gavelkind.translation:
n. (无遗嘱时)死者土地均分制
[法] 平均继承制或习惯

   played twice over.
